Marvel फैन्स, तैयार हो जाइए क्योंकि box office पर अब तक का सबसे बड़ा मुकाबला शुरू होने वाला है! 🎬

18 December को release होने जा रही फिल्म Avengers: Doomsday ने worldwide pre-sales में $125 million से ज्यादा का कलेक्शन कर लिया है।

North America box office पर ऑल-टाइम बिगेस्ट comic book movie बनने के लिए इस फिल्म को $960 million का टारगेट हासिल करना होगा।

अभी यह रिकॉर्ड Spider-Man: Brand New Day के पास है, जिसने North America में $958.5 million कमाए हैं।

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, Robert Downey Jr. की वापसी वाली यह फिल्म Thunderbolts के 14 महीने बाद की कहानी दिखाएगी और worldwide $3 billion का आंकड़ा भी छू सकती है। 💥

क्या आपको लगता है कि Avengers: Doomsday यह बड़ा रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
Avengers: Doomsday is nearing release, with less than two months left. The MCU biggie has been generating quite the buzz with its insane pre-sales worldwide. It is expected to open with massive numbers at the North American box office, but will it beat Spider-Man: Brand New Day’s domestic total to become the all-time highest-grossing comic book movie? Keep scrolling for the target Robert Downey Jr’s MCU return movie must earn to achieve this remarkable feat at the domestic box office.
The movie is one of the most anticipated films among comic-book movie fans, especially Marvel fans. After an extraordinary performance by the Tom Holland-starrer Spidey movie this year, the excitement around this has further increased. However, as per reports, Holland might not appear in this upcoming MCU magnum opus, but RDJ reuniting with the OG Avengers cast is equally exciting. There are very high hopes around this Marvel biggie.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day was released on the last day of July, and it recorded the biggest opening weekend of all time at the North American box office. It is the 2nd film in Hollywood history to cross the $900 million milestone at the North American box office, and it also broke Star Wars: The Force Awakens ‘ 11-year-old record, becoming the all-time highest-grossing film domestically.
According to Box Office Mojo , Spider-Man: Brand New Day has collected over $958.5 million at the domestic box office so far, with the total still rising. It is also the only comic book movie ever to achieve this number domestically. Therefore, Avengers: Doomsday must earn $960 million to comfortably beat the Tom Holland starrer as the all-time biggest comic book movie in North America. If it did so, the Robert Downey Jr . starrer will also become the biggest domestic blockbuster ever. It will thus achieve two milestones by beating one movie.
The film takes place 14 months after the events of Thunderbolts (2025), as the multiverse is on the verge of collapse. Heroes from three different universes, including the Avengers, Wakandans, and New Avengers from Earth-616, the Fantastic Four from Earth-828, and the X-Men from Earth-10005, unite to confront the existential threat posed by Doctor Doom. Avengers: Doomsday has reportedly surpassed $125 million in worldwide pre-sales. It could also be the only movie ever to cross the $3 billion milestone worldwide. Avengers: Doomsday will be released on December 18.
